items.topic: Run the full restructure now, with parallel fast subagents
items.claim: Agent proposed options for the test KB; the 'full restructure takes days' estimate was wrong.
items.fact: Operator: do the whole restructure (restructure-blueprints-for-kb), commit state first, then run the webshop test in a new folder created from the ESM fullstack template. Use up to 25 parallel subagents. Use the 'fast' role for each subagent with a lot of work. Use a research subagent only where thinking is needed. Spawn a background subagent to work on the test project. Subagents lose all knowledge, so they must recover it via kb_search.

items.claim: The full restructure (tasks 2-6) would take days.
items.fact: Operator: "You can run 25 paralell subagents it will not take days! ... do the whole!" Agents should parallelize heavily instead of proposing a reduced scope.

The webshop test app must contain at least 50 prewritten functions, increasingly complicated, that all webshops have. When it is done, try it in a browser tool in Docker and check each function with subagents. Use background subagents for parallel code checks.

items.topic: Pin agent-docs import to template commit 6273a87
items.fact: Import agent-docs from judo-esm-fullstack-project-template@6273a87 (the review's preferred base). The commit before 5bddd8b ('JNG-6380 Remove agent-docs from the template') differs by only 8 files. Render the Handlebars to static markdown and drop domain/. The domain/ dir is generated per model by generate-domain-docs.sh. Agent used neutral model name 'myapp'. Renderer: openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/oneoff/agent-docs-import/render.py.

Template agent-docs (.hbs) use only: {{{docLink "path" "text" "skill"}}} (89x), {{{localHubLink "text" "skill"}}} (44x), {{ lowerCase model.name }} (219x), {{ model.name }}, escaped literals (\\{{ }}), and a few #if/#each/#unless blocks that appear only as examples. Helpers are in EsmProjectHelper.java (docLink at line 182, docLinkSimple at 222), in judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-common. docLink becomes [text](path) and localHubLink becomes [text](./README.md).

items.topic: model-development.md: only the Designer may edit the model
items.claim: "The ESM model file (/model/webshop.model) is complex XML (XMI) and must not be modified by hand. Always use the Judo Designer graphical modeling tool to make changes."
items.fact: The model must not be hand-edited as text, but the JUDO Model CLI is the supported way to change it, alongside the Designer. The template version has a 'Working-copy safety' section instead. The agent replaced the paragraph with 'Do not edit the model file by hand': use the CLI (judo-cli.md) or the Designer, because hand edits break xmi:id cross-references. The hardcoded 'webshop.model' name is also wrong, since the file is model/<app>.model.

items.topic: agent-docs README points to a local .claude skill
items.claim: "## CLI Documentation: For JUDO Model CLI commands, see the judo-model-cli skill in .claude/skills/judo-model-cli/."
items.fact: Replace with '## Platform CLI', linking model/judo-cli.md (why the CLI is mandatory, platform invariants) and model/transformation-pipeline.md (ESM → PSM → ASM → RDBMS → Liquibase, server vs client regeneration, in-memory state). The .claude directory is removed in the restructure.

items.topic: Template agent-docs are a superset of the catalog copy
items.fact: The template has docs missing from the catalog copy: model/judo-cli.md, model/transformation-pipeline.md, model/ui-authoring-guide.md. model-development.md gains about 181 lines: working-copy safety, authoritative function registry, '5. JQL Pitfalls & Scoping Rules' (5.1 lambda scopes do not nest, 5.2 primitives must be fully qualified), and '!any()' usage. advanced-modeling-patterns.md gains patterns for mapped managed principal with claim mapping, role flags on the principal, ACTOR vs PRINCIPAL vs USER variables, asymmetric bidirectional relations (AGGREGATION × ASSOCIATION), and derived-member self-binding. JQL gotchas: !getVariable returns only a scalar String, and Sequence<String>!getVariable is invalid grammar. Bipartite quantifiers cannot be expressed in a DERIVED DataMember.

Jar: judo-ng/runtime/judo-model-cli/target/judo-model-cli-1.1.0-SNAPSHOT-standalone.jar, with commit 9f6a4bd (mermaid, authoring) an ancestor of HEAD. Usage: java -jar <jar> -m <model> <cmd>. Commands: query, graphql, create, update, delete, move, relocate (change parent, keeps identity), fill (populate a TO view/form/table), split, mermaid (draw as classDiagrams), save (merges unsaved edits, never runs git), merge (merge a copy from another worktree, reports conflicts with fix commands), discard, validate, transform, server. Flags: --dry-run, --json, --mermaid, --no-check (bulk edits, then validate at the end), --brief, --schema[=<field>] (describes fields and valid values, changes nothing), -s key=value (a,b replaces a list), --ns namespace FQN. Start-up about 0.4s.

items.topic: kb_get needs the catalog-relative path; kb guard
items.fact: kb_get with path 'agent-docs/deployment/build-process.md' returned not found. The KB indexes paths as they exist on disk, and the dirs were not yet moved to catalog/. The kb guard nags after 3 consecutive source searches without a kb_search ('Run kb_search ... before the next source search'). kb_search 'create new JUDO project from fullstack template generate-root' returns agent-docs/deployment/build-process.md 'How the Project is Generated' first.

items.topic: How to create a new project from the ESM fullstack template
items.claim: build-process.md only says the project was 'initially generated using the JUDO ESM Fullstack Project Template' with generator-parameter.properties.
items.fact: There is no how-to for creating a new project. Template modules: judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-{root,application,common,test}. The artifacts are in ~/.m2/repository/hu/blackbelt/judo/template/judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-root/ (versions 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT and 1.0.0.20260903_235856_3b675ffd_develop). The root module's resources (judo-ng/template/.../judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-root/src/main/resources) contain pom.xml.hbs, judo.sh.hbs, generator-parameter.properties.hbs, AGENTS.md.hbs, README.adoc.hbs and pom.xml.*.fragment.hbs. The pom has a generate-root execution with synchronizeGitignore (esm=${basedir}/model/{{createdModelName}}.model, ignoredFiles pom.xml,**/pom.xml,judo.sh,.mvn/jvm.config). Generated projects use ./judo.sh build and need Docker. ~/.m2/settings.xml needs a <server> with id '<app>-distribution'. A model lives in model/<app>.model. A how-to for creating from scratch should be written.

items.topic: git rm refuses staged renames; use -f
items.fact: After git mv, 'git rm' fails with 'the following file has changes staged in the index' for moved files. Use git rm -r -f --ignore-unmatch, then git add -A.

items.topic: Spawning background pi sessions via the dashboard MCP
items.fact: Subagent sessions can be spawned with mcp__pi_dashboard__spawn_session (spawn a pi session in a working directory), found via tool_search 'background subagent spawn async status'. Related tools: list_sessions, get_git_status. The KB extension is @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-kb-extension. Its dist/cli.js has --help, and the DB and sources are configured in .pi/dashboard/knowledge_base.json, with the index at ~/.pi/dashboard/kb.
